subject.title: feat(repair): add digest-bound Gitcrawl evidence intake

question: Should the Gitcrawl evidence stack land now with mandatory legacy-job migration and fail-closed cloud/parity provider behavior?
rationale: Tests can establish correctness, but only repository owners can accept the intentional operator migration, external-service dependency, and landing-order obligations.

options.title: Accept the full contract
options.body: Land the exact stacked head after all checks pass and an operator rehearses migration, rollback, publication, and recovery.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Defer cloud and parity modes to reduce the initial authentication, compatibility, and availability surface.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep the draft open until its action-ledger base and operational ownership are ready.

recommendation.title: Accept the full contract
recommendation.body: Land the exact stacked head after all checks pass and an operator rehearses migration, rollback, publication, and recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns the feature design and hardening history and is best positioned to present its migration and provider contract for final acceptance.
